Your holdings: SOXL (-52.31%) and SPAL (-39.84%) are deep in the red and leveraged; margin amplifies these drops. QQQI (-3.08%) is nearing its stop. CRWD (+25.26%) is surging on strong news.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions for further downside. Also, watch QQQ for a potential add given its scanner setup.

Bottom line: Capitalize on tech strength but aggressively manage risk on your leveraged, underperforming positions.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL: Both leveraged ETFs are deeply negative. Consider trimming or tightening stops to manage margin risk.
Watch QQQI: It's close to its 52 stop; respect that level to prevent further loss.
Consider CRM: Strong news and scanner setup (entry 245.88-244.97, stop 243.16) make it a potential new buy.
